name: pdk-linkml-schema
instr:
Our sample registry lives in SQLite files written with `linkml-sqldb dump`. We've released v2 of the schema (/data/registry/registry-v2.yaml; our databases were built with /data/registry/registry-v1.yaml), and each week's batch has to go into the existing database. But `linkml-sqldb dump -s /data/registry/registry-v2.yaml -D registry.db batch.yaml` on a v1 database just errors out. A copy of the current database is /data/registry/registry.db, and this week's batch is /data/registry/batch-2026-10-06.yaml.

Dumping into an existing database should bring it up to the given schema and then add the batch. Afterwards it must have exactly the tables and columns a dump into a new file creates with that schema, and nothing stored may be lost: a slot whose old name is in its aliases keeps its values, a slot that became multivalued keeps every distinct value each record had, and new slots and classes start out empty. A batch record whose id is already stored replaces the stored record, so dumping the same batch twice leaves the same records as dumping it once. If a slot that is now required has no value on some stored records, the dump should fail, name those records' ids, and leave the database as it was.

`linkml-sqldb load` should then return every record in the database as one document, not only the first dump's. The existing tests in /app/tests and the repository's ruff lint and format checks must still pass.

Could you find what's wrong and fix it? There's no network; the project
